name: GET /api/admin/voice-agent/routing/numbers/:phone_number - Resolve an inbound call (operator)
description: What the voice runtime calls when an INVITE arrives (8076dcb4-e91f-46a5-9825-f6bf2e2b2a47#AC4, 8076dcb4-e91f-46a5-9825-f6bf2e2b2a47#AC5). An INVITE carries only the dialled number, so this resolves ACROSS tenants and is therefore operator-only: it authenticates with x-admin-ops-token and a tenant JWT is 401. action=agent with the live version_id when the agent is published and not killed; otherwise action=fallback with reason not_published | paused | archived | kill_switch, the binding's fallback and fallback_target, and kill_message when the kill switch is engaged. In the dependency chain the agent has not been published, so the call takes the fallback. An unbound number is 404.

testCases.name: Unpublished agent routes the call to the fallback

errorCases.when: x-admin-ops-token missing or wrong (a tenant JWT is not accepted)

errorCases.message: number is not bound to an active agent
errorCases.when: no active binding for the number
